title: The Young Alliance Master returns
summary: Two years after the Demon Flame space closed, Xiao Yan and Xun Er come out. On the way Xiao Yan saves an outer squad of the Sky Mansion Alliance from a Hall of Souls attack while they carry Demon Fire Stones, and then wipes out a nearby Hall of Souls branch, held by a One-Star Dou Sheng, in one move. The squad learns he is the Young Alliance Master and tells him the Stone Clan and Spirit Clan have vanished and three clans have allied, and Xun Er leaves to check on the Gu Clan. At the alliance, the leaders fear Hun Qianmo, a Six-Star Dou Sheng of the Hun Clan who helped ambush Xiao Xuan, as well as Hun Miesheng and the Soul Demon Elder, because Zi Yan must stay on East Dragon Island. Xiao Yan walks in, says he will take on Hun Miesheng, and is welcomed home. He hears that Medusa is still in seclusion deep in the Nine Serene Spring, and he rallies the alliance to drive the Hall of Souls out of the Central Plains. Both sides gather at Fallen Mountain, the Hall of Souls with seven Dou Sheng and the alliance with ten.
events: Xiao Yan and Xun Er leave the Demon Flame space after two years.
Xiao Yan saves an alliance squad carrying Demon Fire Stones.
He destroys a nearby Hall of Souls branch in one move.

The alliance's leaders weigh the threat of Hun Qianmo.
Xiao Yan returns and offers to fight Hun Miesheng.
He hears that Medusa is still in the Nine Serene Spring.
The Hall of Souls and the alliance gather at Fallen Mountain.

690-809s: the alliance leaders speaking are not named. 797.6 'I can handle the Soul Demon Elder' may be Xiao Chen; 759.3 'the Ancestor' is probably the Pill Tower Ancestor.
882.0-916.1: the welcoming speakers are not named; Yao Lao is listed from 676.6 'Are Teacher and the others still doing well?'.
Hun Qianmo appears on screen only in the briefing (703-716s), if at all; 721.4 the ancient clans' rule now bars Four-Star Dou Sheng or higher from intervening.
